items.rationale: A model call is stateless and a session's context is discarded when it ends, so anything from Monday must be saved by the program and put back into the context. Options a, b and c assume the model or the program keeps Monday's text without being told to.
Each call carries the base plus every earlier addition: 2,000 + 2,250 + 2,500 + 2,750 = 9,500. An answer of 2,750 gives only the last call's input.

Booking a machine is a permission with real-world risk, so it rests on the authoritative training record, read through a tool at the moment of the decision. A saved note is a copy that can be stale and a student's confirmation is only a claim; refusing outright ignores that the record can be read.
Recall is relevant pages found divided by all relevant pages: 2 / 4 = 0.5. An answer of 0.4 is the precision, 2 / 5.

items.answer: It costs input tokens at every call, and the model's accuracy falls as the context fills (context rot).
